inputs.name: Test input
inputs.description: Checks that Flow runs a task inside an Apptainer container and stages a Flow data file into it.

input_file.name: Any small file
input_file.description: Any uploaded file, for example region_R1.tar.gz. The task only counts its bytes.

image.name: Container image
image.description: Image to run the task in. Without a scheme it is pulled as docker://<name>.

outputs.name: Apptainer report
outputs.description: Nextflow version, container image, OS and Python seen inside the task.
